events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Jared Goff passed for career highs of 465 yards and five touchdowns, winning a scintillating duel with Kirk Cousins and leading the unbeaten Los Angeles Rams to a 38-31 victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff has 465 yards, 5 TDs, propels Rams past Vikings, 38-31

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw a 13-yard touchdown pass to A.J. Green with 7 seconds remaining, lifting the Cincinnati Bengals to a 37-36 win over the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton's late TD pass to Green lifts Bengals over Falcons

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Mitchell Trubisky threw a career-high six touchdown passes and the NFC North-leading Chicago Bears pounded the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 48-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trubisky throws for 6 TDs, Bears pound Buccaneers 48-10

headlines.description: Brett Maher kicked a 38-yard field goal as time expired, lifting the Dallas Cowboys to a 26-24 victory over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brett Maher FG on final play lifts Cowboys over Lions 26-24

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers and Jimmy Graham connected on their first touchdown pass of the year, and the Green Bay Packers put together their most complete defensive effort of the season in a 22-0 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers put together complete effort in 22-0 win over Bills

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota hit Corey Davis with a 10-yard touchdown pass just before the end of overtime, and the Tennessee Titans beat the Philadelphia Eagles 26-23 on Sunday for their best start since 2013.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariota outduels Wentz as Titans edge Eagles 26-23 in OT

headlines.description: Ka'imi Fairbairn took advantage of his second chance on a 37-yard field goal attempt Sunday, making it as time expired in overtime to give the Houston Texans a 37-34 victory over the Indianapolis Colts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans end losing streak in OT after Vinatieri sets record

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 274 yards and three touchdowns and the New England Patriots handed Miami its first loss of the season in a 38-7 rout on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots stop skid, hand Dolphins 1st loss in 38-7 rout

events.name: New York Jets at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Blake Bortles threw two touchdown passes, including a 67-yarder to Donte Moncrief, and the Jacksonville Jaguars used a dominant defensive performance to handle the New York Jets 31-12 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bortles tosses 2 TD passes Jags handle Darnold, Jets 31-12

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw four TD passes and a game-tying 2-point conversion with 30 seconds left in regulation to set up Matt McGrane's 29-yard field goal in overtime that gave the Oakland Raiders their first win since Jon Gruden's return as coach, 45-42 over...
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders rally past Browns 45-42 in OT for 1st win for Gruden

headlines.description: Sebastian Janikowski, who had missed twice earlier in the game, kicked a 52-yard field goal as time expired to give Seattle a 20-17 victory over Arizona on Sunday and spoil the debut of Cardinals rookie Josh Rosen as the starting quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Janikowski's late FG spoils Rosen's 1st start

events.name: New Orleans Saints at New York Giants

headlines.description: Alvin Kamara ran for three second-half touchdowns and the New Orleans Saints' defense stepped out of Drew Brees' shadow in a 33-18- victory over the New York Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kamara runs for 3 second-half TDs, Saints beat Giants 33-18

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for three touchdowns, Melvin Gordon rushed for 104 yards and the Los Angeles Chargers rallied for a 29-27 victory over the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers throws for 3 TDs as Chargers rally  to beat 49ers

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw a pair of early touchdown passes, Justin Tucker kicked four second-half field goals and the Baltimore Ravens pulled away from the Pittsburgh Steelers 26-14 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco throws 2 TD passes, Ravens trip up Steelers 26-14

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes rallied the unbeaten Kansas City Chiefs back from a 10-point deficit in the fourth quarter for a 27-23 win over the Denver Broncos on Monday night.
